6jHe, Allah, is One)-) that is. He is the One and unique, to Whom

Sooral al-lkhlas
(1-4) | 467
The inhabitants of both the upper and lower realms are in the
utmost need of Him; they ask Him for what they need and turn to Him
regarding that which concerns them, because He is the only One Who
is perfect in His attributes, the All-Knowing Who is perfect in His
knowledge, the Forbearing Who is perfect in His forbearance, the Most
Merciful Who is perfect in His mercy, Whose mercy encompasses all
things... and so on with all His attributes.
In His perfection, f|He begets not nor was He begotten]* because
He is completely independent of means,
s(and there is none comparable to Him]* either in His names, attributes
or deeds - blessed and exalted be He.
This soorah refers to the oneness of the divine names and attributes
( tawheed al-asma' wa$-$ifdt).
All praise and thanks are for Allah, and may the blessings and
peace of Allah be upon Prophet Muhammad (s^g). his family, and
his Companions abundantly until the Day of Judgement.
